notes.content:
Recently, we have received numerous reports from players experiencing prolonged freezing on the logo screen when running "BlazBlue Entropy Effect," followed by a "program not responding" message from Windows.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43561596/77a6e046fe95653c24ab1e59edc5d0cb3f0c55e0.png
After investigation, we have identified that the real-time scanning feature of Windows Defender Antivirus (the built-in Windows antivirus software) continuously scans the game directory and processes during game startup, causing the game to time out.

To avoid this issue, we recommend taking one of the following measures:

 Try using other antivirus software. Windows Defender Antivirus will be automatically disabled at this time.
 When Windows prompts that BlazBlueEntropyEffect.exe is not responding, select "Wait for program to respond." The game will eventually run normally after the scan is complete.
 Add the game directory to the Windows Defender Antivirus whitelist.


If you want to add the game directory to the Windows Defender Antivirus whitelist, you can refer to the following brief tutorial:
[olist]
 Locate your game installation directory. You can find it in your Steam library by right-clicking the game icon, then selecting "Manage" -> "Browse local files." The folder that opens is your game installation directory.
 Open Windows Security Center, select "Virus & threat protection" -> "Manage settings."
 Click "Add or remove exclusions," select "Folder," and add the game directory obtained in the first step.
[/olist]
For detailed instructions on using Windows Security Center in Windows, please refer to the official Microsoft documentation: Virus and Threat Protection in the Windows Security App

For system security, we do not recommend completely disabling your antivirus software. We are still investigating the specific reasons for the prolonged scanning of the game by Windows Defender Antivirus.

notes.title: Couch co-op & Japanese Voice-over of ICEY is live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thank you for your patience and understanding, couch co-op is released at last! We did a mini-tutorial in Vlog to introduce this new function; you will also find the tutorial of how to set the LAN co-op up in this Vlog, because we still see a lot of players asking help on it.

[previewyoutube=zJdsZBPdnRw;full][/previewyoutube]

If you couldn’t watch video, here is a short instruction of couch co-op:

How to launch it:

 As usual, you’ll start a new Mind Training session by stepping through the teleportation gate as the tiny robot. But this time, when you wake up in the familliar black room, you’ll notice a brand-new option: Local Co-op Mind Training.
 To begin, make sure you and your partner’s controllers or keyboards are properly connected. Follow the on-screen instructions to bind your controls. Once everything’s set up, you’re ready to go!
 Only Master Player, AKA the one who binds their controls first, can choose 2 EvoTypes. These Evotypes will determine the Legacy Skills available during the run, and the skills from both chosen Evotypes will apply to both players.
 During the run, each player can select their own Potentials, while only Master Player can choose which path to take, what to select in Exchange Rooms, which legacy skill to upgrade and more. Those choices affect both players, so make sure to communicate well—or just let the more bad-ass one between you take the lead!
 In battle, if one of you goes down, the run doesn’t end. You will revive once your partner clears the current room. But what happens if both players die…? Well, you tell me…


As to LAN co-op:

 First things first, you’ll still need to go through the teleportation passage and enter the Mode Selection Room.
 From there, select Online Mind Training and confirm to connect to the network.
 Now, here’s the key part—Do not start the game yet. Instead, open the Online Settings Dashboard.
 On the left side, you’ll see an option called “ACE Connection Area.” Click that.
 At the top of this menu, you’ll find “Enable LAN Server.” Just turn that on!
 Once your LAN server is up, your friend should be able to see it and join you from the same screen on their end.


Yeah, we know—it’s kind of buried in the menus. Sorry about that! The good news is the dev team is actively working on a co-op polish plan to improve the performance and overall user experience.
It’s not dropping super soon, probably at the very end of this year, but we wanted you to know: we hear you, and we’re working on it.

Japanese Voice-over of ICEY is out too!
The voice-over in Japanese is performed by the original voice actor, Shimono Hiro, in ICEY. Thanks to his authentic performance that we can say the work on ICEY is finally completed.
No need for extra words—here’s a brand-new trailer to give you a sneak peek!

[previewyoutube=qX3bzPGavnQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Other than these, we also fixed and improved bits and bobs with the patch:

Character Improvements and Bug Fixes

 The text description for Rachel's Potential [Ivy Blossom] has been updated to clarify the ability to throw multiple crosses.
 Fixed an issue where Rachel's Potential [Sankishin: Tsukuyomi Unit]'s invincibility state failed to defend against Susanoo's ultimate skill in Advanced Transcendence difficulty.
 Fixed an issue where ICEY could remain invincible during certain moves.
 Fixed an issue where ICEY could not crouch immediately after a ground attack.
 Fixed an issue where some of ICEY's moves could knock back the Defiling Eye.
 Fixed an issue where the actual damage of [Shift] did not match the displayed value when ICEY had a high MP reserve.
 Fixed an issue where the unlock condition for the hidden effect of Hazama's Potential [Eternal Coils of the Dragon Serpent] was displayed incorrectly.
 Resolved the issue where Hazama's Potential [Ouroboros] invincible dodge state was improperly overwritten.
 Adjusted the pre-input criteria for Hazama's Potential [Ouroboros] related to [Vengeful Viper] derivatives.
 Addressed the issue where Hazama's Potential [The Serpent's Unholy Wrath] MP absorption was below the expected value.
 Corrected the display error for the unlock condition of the hidden effect 'MP Recover enhancement' in Hazama's Potential [Ouroboros].
 Fixed the issue where Noel's Potential [Zero-gun: Sleipnir] invincibility frames were incorrectly overwritten upon activation.
 Fixed an issue where certain move effects in Mai's Palette were displayed incorrectly.


Other optimizations and bug fixes

 Resolved an issue where specific Tactics caused data desynchronization and level skipping in online play.
 Fixed a bug where the death animation played incorrectly when a character was defeated mid-air.
 Removed the damage from the knockback move preceding Susanoo's ultimate skill in Advanced Transcendence difficulty.
 Reduced the damage of some of Susanoo's moves in Advanced Transcendence difficulty and enhanced the Attack direction judgment for certain moves.
 Improved the visual and audio effects of Susanoo's ultimate skill in Advanced Transcendence difficulty.
 Resolved the issue with the incorrect display of the maximum number of Tactics for the Bladestorm style.
 Improved the trigger slot and display of Double Tactic and associated Tactics within the Tactic Tree.

notes.title: New DLC Reveal - Wishlist now & Couch co-op coming on 20th May!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

It's been a month since we announced the Dead Cells crossover, but now it's time to shift gears and reveal our next big update: a brand-new DLC is on the way!

New BlazBlue Character Incoming
If you've been following us for a while, you probably know the pattern: crossover characters are normally free, while new DLC introduces an official BlazBlue character to Entropy Effect. So… who's stepping into the spotlight this time?

[previewyoutube=sJHjFdciZ80;full][/previewyoutube]

That's right, Bullet is back with her signature Smash Hail and notorious grab moves! The DLC store page is already live on Steam, wishlist now and keep an eye on our social media for more gameplay preview and launch date soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3681910/BlazBlue_Entropy_Effect__Bullet_Character_Pack/

How do we choose which BB character to add?
As some of you might know, our producer Michael likes to stream on bilibili (China's version of YouTube) to talk about anything new regarding the game from time to time. Due to limited budget, we're not able to translate the whole stream in English, but we will do a recap every time on X (Twitter) and Discord from now on (so now's a good time for you to follow us on X or join our Discord channel).

In the last stream, Michael explained how we select new BB characters by considering several aspects:
 Will the mechanics of this character bring something unique and more playablity to the game?
 Is his/her combat style and weapon distinct enough from existing characters?
 How popular he/she is among BB players?
 And yes, we try to alternate between male and female characters.

With that in mind, it should be clear why Bullet is making her debut now—and maybe you can even guess who might come next! ;)

Naoto When?
When it comes to the selection of characters, Michael also mentioned Naoto (I know, I know…). 

First thing first, we do know the game icon is Naoto not Ragna… 

In fact, Naoto should've been the 10th character. However, during Early Access, we gradually formed the selection philosophy and so Taokaka ended up taking that spot. After Taokaka, a lot of things happened (we even shut down the studio...), we failed in bringing Naoto back to the roadmap while Rachel and Hazama seemed a better choice for us because of their unique mechanics and combat style.

So… Naoto when? 
We honestly don't know. But we do want to bring him in eventually. We'll keep trying!

While you'll have to wait a little longer for Bullet (and even longer for Naoto), something exciting is just around the corner...

Couch co-op will launch on 20th May PT!
We can't wait to see you guys playing this game with your friends, your kids, your partners and even your parents!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43561596/0fad6fcf881c262b10b3902bd97d0fbeb9b3eff4.png

See you in the game!
91Act

notes.title: Roadmap 2025 is here: new character, new crossover, new difficulty and more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

It’s been a month since our last update, and we've just finished our holiday break and returned to work for the past two weeks! During this time, we've been busy planning and organizing our schedule for the continued development of BBEE.  

It's been a challenging task because this is the first time we’ve had to create a full year-long plan after the game’s 1.0 launch. What will the future of BBEE be like as a game? Which parts of the game do we still want to improve? How can we bring more value to our players? These are some of the questions we've been working through.  

It’s been a tiring process, but also rewarding because... we’re finally ready to share our update roadmap for 2025! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43561596/f5b387edb31cede4c38b3939f05e9eabd2ceb589.jpg

Well, we call it “a roadmap”, but there is in fact no set timeline on it. It’s pretty hard for us to set everything in stone because we’re quite a small team, which makes it hard to be certain of timelines. Game development likes to throw up surprises too, so we don’t want to promise you dates we’re not sure of! 

Saying that, we’re confident in our ability to deliver this content this year. So let’s elaborate a bit more on a couple of points of this roadmap. 

New Surprise Crossover 

Yeah, we already started to plan our next crossover! But we still can’t say if it will feature a new character, or if it will be something different. The only thing we can confirm is it will be free, again! 

Global Mobile Version & More Languages 

“Mobile when?” “New language when?” 

We have seen these comments thousands of times since 1.0 launch and we finally have bandwidth (and money) to do them this year!!! In the first half of the year, we will mainly focus on these 2 parts and hopefully they will be shipped soon! 

We’re really excited about what’s coming, and we can’t wait to bring these updates to you. Stay tuned for more details, and as always, feel free to share your thoughts with us. 

See you in the game, 
91Act Team

notes.title: Anniversary of 1.0 Launch: Behind the Scenes + Preview of Biggest Ever Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone and Happy New Year! 


I am Michael, the producer of BlazBlue Entropy Effect and head of the 91Act studio. I rarely present myself here, but as some of you might have noticed, it usually means there’s something big coming... 

Most of you have just finished the New Year holiday, but for us Chinese New Year is just around the corner! It’s not only the most important festival of the year for us, but also the most important period for BBEE as a game. 

We’re almost at the 1st anniversary of our 1.0 launch, so we’re going to celebrate this milestone with our biggest ever free update with a new boss, a new character with a special set of levels to unlock & them & learn their moveset, PLUS a new Character DLC! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43561596/0fcac05794bf31b2897cc079137736cc61630618.jpg
A tiny hint here, look at this chain, guess who is coming!

But first, a little story about how our studio very nearly died just days after the 1.0 release, and how my team helped bring us back from the brink... 

*If you are not interested in our story, please scroll down to the end, there will be a small preview of the upcoming update & DLC. 


WHAT'S THE STORY?

On 31st Jan 2024, just 10 days before Chinese New Year that year, we finished the Early Access and launched the 1.0 version of BBEE.  

For a studio that had spent 10 years developing mobile games, this was by far our greatest professional moment – creating an excellent PC action game was just an absolutely wild dream for us! It's still sometimes hard for us to believe it. 

But, we (well, mainly I and the shareholders) had to decide to shut down the studio on 5th February 2024, just 5 days after launch and only 5 days before the Chinese New Year holidays. 

You're probably asking yourself why? Why did we have to shut down the studio while the game was doing well? How are we still updating the game now?  

We've never told this story to players outside of China before, although some of you may have heard bits and pieces, but at this special point - the anniversary of 1.0 launch - we’d like to share our experience with you and express our unending gratitude of your support. 


THE BEGINNING 

Like most of Chinese developers, I began my career at big gaming companies like Tencent and Shanda. After a decade of experience in these companies, I needed to make something I truly wanted to make, so I took a leap and founded 91Act.  

Mobile gaming was, and still is, the absolutely dominant market in China, and my experience was mainly in mobile too, so 91Act actually started as a mobile game developer. 

Our first major success was BlazBlue Revolution Reburning, a mobile adaptation of the fighting game BlazBlue. I’ve always believed BlazBlue was the best work to come out of the 2D fighting era, so when we were thinking about the prototype of 91Act’s first game, I pushed to make a demo based on BlazBlue, which managed to get us a meeting with the producer of BlazBlue and the top management of Arc System Works and they let us make the game! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43561596/3138a9e30f743dfac90b8d51ab1563105c6f9bc4.png
BlazBlue Revolution Reburning

Afterward, we developed Crossing Void – a turn-based RPG mobile game. Unfortunately, that project didn’t reach the same level of success. By the time it was shut down in 2020, the losses left us in a difficult position financially.  

HAIL MARY TIME 

This was the first time I felt that 91Act might just have to shut down, and unfortunately it wasn't the last time either. However, the gaming boom during COVID opened a door for us, as a lot of money poured into the industry.  

With new investment, we pitched another BlazBlue project to Arc. This time, we wanted to create something bigger – a premium PC game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43561596/dba368ad534d9a7acb0231b32d067566cb555cab.png
A big inspiration for BlazBlue Entropy Effect - BlazBlue Calamity Trigger (2008)!

With existing development assets from our previous Blazblue project and the core members from that project still at 91Act, everything was set up for success. Indeed, production went well, and we managed to get a decent success over the five months of Early Access, amassing 5.4k reviews at 94.96% positive by the end of January 2024.  

But things took a turn at the 1.0 release. Due to my lack of experience with PC games and players, I decided to make some big changes in the 1.0 version which were intended to address your feedback but ended up annoying many of you instead. Reviews just dropped to Mixed overnight and sales failed to meet expectations. 

Normally, the underperformance of sales wouldn’t cause a devastating blow to a 10-year-old company, but we were facing another huge financial issue at that moment – we hadn’t received payments from our publisher on another important project for a long time. For a combination of reasons, the company's cash flow was completely broken. 

OUR LOWEST POINT 

So this was the second time I believed that 91Act might just stop right there, but I was not as lucky as the first time. After discussions with shareholders, I had to make the decision to let the entire team go before the Chinese New Year.  

It wasn’t something I wanted, but it was the only way to ensure we could compensate everyone fairly. I mortgaged my house and pooled that money with all the cash from the company’s account to cover salaries, severance pay, and partial overtime payments. 

It wasn’t a perfect solution, but I honestly tried my best to honor the team’s work as best as I could and I'm not sure what else I could have done differently - it was and still is a very difficult time for smaller game studios to survive financially, let alone thrive. 

To my surprise, the team were way calmer than I expected, some folks even consoled ME before they left the office. What I remember most is one who left some oranges on my desk and told me not to be sad. Others even offered to stay and work for free temporarily to continue the development of BBEE to try to save the studio. 

Young people are always impulsive, and as their (former) boss and elder, I greatly appreciated their dedication, but still told them to go home for the New Year first and think calmly about their future and careers. As for me, as founder of the studio I needed to do what I could to make things right. 

BRIGHTER SKIES AHEAD 

That night I did a live stream on Bilibili (huge social media platform in China) to explain everything to our players and promising that I will continue development, even if it had to be on my own. To my complete surprise, way more people than I expected came to the stream and expressed their support for the team. 

What surprised me more was part of the team returned (as well as being impulsive, young people also never listen to advice haha), freely volunteering their time for a planned update during the holiday. This update, thanks to the team's efforts, became the turning point of the game as it won players' trust back and Steam reviews gradually turned to positive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43561596/aade9d79655a3a992d071cab8402ddf1bc6a0e90.png
The negative reviews here were much more at the time, before players changed their reviews back to positive

Our story also became known to the industry and the broader gaming community thanks to several reports from the gaming outlets in China. Sales of the game picked back up and hope began to emerge again.

We still don’t have any idea how or why our story attracted that much attention at that moment. Probably it’s because everyone likes gossip and this was basically the first time such a drama had happened out in the open in the Chinese gaming industry; or maybe it’s because a lot of people were being empathetic as year-end layoffs were happening a lot for everyone.  

But in any case, we survived, thanks to the efforts of my team and the incredible support and encouragement from you guys, our players! 

WE'RE STILL HERE! 

As sales picked up and reviews improved, I was able to bring most of the team back on reduced salaries after the Chinese New Year, gradually increasing their compensation as sales grew of course. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43561596/f8b735c4765940c65a7a5e091bc6bdce388e309a.png
The day we officially reorganized the team after the CNY holiday 

Since then, we’ve released regular updates, new content, and even a mobile version (China only) of BBEE in 2024. The game sales also broke 700,000 last September, which I would never have believed a year ago. We're stable, growing, and we have even more planned for this year - I can't wait to show you what we're preparing! 

Finally, I'd like to say again that I'm extremely grateful for the team here at 91Act who have stuck with me through one of the worst ever periods for the gaming industry with layoffs and game studio closures happening constantly. They really went above and beyond and I want you to know it!

So that was our 2024, ups and downs, right? Even now, I still can’t believe that we are still here and about to celebrate the 1st anniversary of the 1.0 launch and our rebirth!

Anyway, let's get back to the game.

OUR ANNIVERSARY PACK - THE BIGGEST UPDATE EVER!

First up we have a new boss, Reki

Crossover with ICEY

If you are a 2D Action Platformer enthusiast, you might have heard about this game before, it's very popular here in China. The crossover with ICEY will bring a separate series of customized levels to discover the character, and the brand-new playable character herself – ICEY - into the world of ACE.

Character DLC
Lastly, but most importantly, a brand-new character DLC will bring the highly anticipated HAZAMA to the game!

This is just a short preview of our Anniversary Update, we are going to reveal much more information next week. Please keep an eye on our YouTube, X and Discord accounts (and here of course!) for the launch date, more trailers, more gameplay footage and other surprising content! 

Thank you for everyone’s support in 2024,

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43561596/a0c9cae45a27ed2f03b8945b6d5d8128cd90828a.png
Hey everyone!

We know most of you are already in the mood of Christmas and can’t wait for the super long holiday. Though it’s not a tradition to celebrate Christmas in China, we still want to take this opportunity to do a summary of 2024 and to set up some resolutions for BBEE in 2025.

We believe that we have never talked about our crazy 2024 before, but it’s truly a roller coaster ride for us. It’s been almost a year since our 1.0 launch, but honestly, if it was us a year ago, we would have been surprised that we survived. You might be already curious about this story, but it’s too long and contains too much emotion. We will find a good timing to tell you the story, but now, let’s get to the point!

A summary of our 2024:

 We finished Early Access development and launched the 1.0 version of the game.
 Rachel DLC was installed: it’s not only our first character DLC, but also a gift to the players who supported us during Early Access.
 Co-op mode was added.
 Boss Rush was added - for those “git-gud” players!
 Characters Improvements: We polished the control and combat of Ragna, Es, etc and re-designed Taokaka to bring each character a more unique combat style and battle strategy (hopefully you can feel it).
 We also did some improvements on boss fight to make the experience more competitive and thrilling.
 The difficulty system was re-designed as well to bring more variety and replayability.
 For the players who like to collect, we installed a decoration system, an in-game mission system and even a music player!
 And… a lot of bugs got fixed, a lot of improvements based on players’ feedback got actualized in 2024.

So, what’s our plan in 2025?
Behold, we are going to release all this content during the first half:

 Several brand-new characters: some of them are the original characters from BlazBlue while some of them will be from our crossover with other IPs.
 New gameplay: we plan to finish the story with the Endless Mode which will also bring more varieties to the game.
 New bosses, enemies, levels and biomes will be added to enrich the experience.
 A higher difficulty level will launch soon, I know some of you have already rolled up your sleeve for battle!
 More legacy skills = more playtime from you!
 More slots to save your Evotype.
 A Lan-party won’t be a dream anymore (wink, wink)!
 More co-op polishing and improvements in other aspects!


During your Christmas holiday, we will still be working as hell to achieve our promise. When you come back from holiday, part of these contents will be released soon before Chinese New Year so that we can enjoy our super long holiday in peace.

Also, there are some contents still in the secret box, we will surprise you when it’s the right timing! Be prepared, and Merry Christmas!

See you in 2025,
91Act Team.

We plan to release an update for the BlazBlue Entropy Effect at the end of this month, which includes numerous new content additions and improvements. Here are some notable changes we’d like to share with you in advance:


 Introducing a new mechanism for Taokaka. The newly redesigned Taokaka will have enhanced performance and a smoother control feel.
 Expansion of the Mind Training content, featuring new Space Covenant and Trial, along with a series of adjustments and optimizations to the mechanics and balance.
 The unlock requirements for Mind Crystals will change to require completing task conditions and spending AP, while upgrading rules will shift to consuming Fragmented Mind. Fragmented Mind used to unlock Mind Crystals before the update will be automatically refunded after the update.
 In Mind Training, Alpha Space will replace Space Omega as the fifth stage. Content related to Space Omega will return in future updates through new gameplay features.
 Save logic optimization: after the update, progress for achievements and the Entropy difficulty system can only be transferred between saves via the [Inherit] function. Additionally, the main menu intro video styles obtained after reaching each ending will now support cross-save unlocking and Steam Cloud Save.


In addition to the above, we’re also bringing numerous optimizations and bug fixes in this update, covering various aspects such as enemy behavior, level design, and system design.

Thank you once again for your patience and support!

notes.title: Pre-Official Release Q&A
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43561596/d0b6580d580261147535392d02c4d62d765a1039.jpg
Q：Did I purchase an Early Access version instead of the official game last August?
A：Yes. The Early Access version was launched on August 16th, 2023, and the official game is scheduled for release on January 31st, 2024. Thus, only the Early Access version has been available prior to the official release.

Q：Do I need to make an additional purchase after buying the Early Access version?
A：No, there is no need to buy the game again. Players who have already purchased the Early Access version can update it to the official version for free, without any additional cost or price difference.

Q：Will there be a discount offered during the official release?
A：Yes, there will be a discount available for the official release. It's recommended that new players purchase the game during that period.

Q：Why was the price raised ahead of schedule, considering no price raise was mentioned during the Early Access phase?
A：To offer new players a discount during the official release, we had to adjust the price earlier than planned due to platform rules. We appreciate your understanding and continued support.

Q：Will my Early Access game saves be transferred to the official version?
A：Unfortunately, the Early Access saves are not compatible with the official version of the game. However, you can still access the Early Access version by following these steps: Go to your Library → find BlazBlue Entropy Effect → right-click on it → select Properties → go to the Betas tab → switch the game to the Early Access version. Your Early Access saves will also remain stored on your local device.

Q：What's the difference between the game's current content and the official version?
A：We have been gathering feedback and making continuous adjustments to the game, right up until recently. The official version will bring notable improvements to key aspects that most players care about, including Potentials, Tactics, the Entropy mechanic, and the out-battle upgrade system. We are excited for you to experience the game in its enhanced form and hope you will enjoy it!

Q：How much new content can we expect in the official version?
A：In the official version, we will introduce 10 characters, along with the complete story content and updates to the existing gameplay.
While we appreciate your anticipation for additional new content, please understand that our primary focus during the Early Access phase has been on adjusting and optimizing the core game experience. Moving forward, we will do our utmost to create more exciting new content for your enjoyment!

Q：Do you have plans for continuous updates in the future?
A：Absolutely! After the official release, our main focus will shift towards creating new content, and we are committed to delivering more exciting content as soon as possible. Please follow our official community channels and stay tuned for more upcoming updates!

Q：Will there be a co-op mode in the future?
A：In the official version, we will introduce a beta version of a "co-op mode," offering you a new way to experience the game. We value player feedback and will diligently work to refine and optimize this new game mode based on your feedback. Let's work together to make the game even more enjoyable!

Q：Will the game still only feature Chinese voice acting?
A：No, in the official version, we will provide voice acting in three languages: Chinese, Japanese, and English. The voice acting of characters from BlazBlue is only available in Japanese.

Q: The game crashes upon launching? 
A: 1. Try disabling antivirus and other security software before launching the game. 2. Attempt to reinstall Steam and the game as well.

Q: Encountered issues like operational freezes and screen freezes during the game?
A: Press ESC to return to the main menu, then re-entering the game can resolve most problems (your current game progress will be saved, even during battles). We are actively working on fixing known issues and will release patches progressively.

Q: I used to be able to run the game without any issues, but sometimes I encountered a black screen upon launching. 
A: Close the game and Steam, navigate to this directory [%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\91Act], delete everything except the "save" folder, then restart the game. 

Q: Steam Deck is unable to run/launch the game properly or experience lag and blurriness? 
A: Although we have tested the compatibility of the Steam Deck, the official compatibility review by Steam is still ongoing. Until it is approved, you will need to manually set up Proton in order to play the game properly. Here are the specific steps for setting it up:
1. Open your Steam Deck's Library and select BlazBlue: Entropy Effect.
2. Click on the cogwheel icon on the right side to open the menu, then click Properties.
3. Navigate to the Compatibility tab.
4. Check the box labeled Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool.
5. Select Proton 8.0-3 from the dropdown menu.
6. Relaunch the game and enjoy!

Q: The game experiences input lag and unresponsive keystrokes in certain usage scenarios?
A: 1. Check if the wireless controller or keyboard has sufficient battery power. 2. It is not recommended to use Bluetooth input devices.

Q: My PS controller is recognized as an Xbox controller?
A: Please try disabling Steam Input in the game's controller settings.

Q: Only gray screen after launching the game?
A: We are currently preparing an update to fix the gray screen issue that occurs on specific language operating systems, such as Turkish. A temporary solution is to change your system's Regional Format to English. You don't need to switch the entire operating system to English. If you have encountered the gray screen issue and your system language is not Turkish, please let us know the language you are using.
